Only when the water level drops do you often realize that your aquarium has a leak. Although water always evaporates, if the water level is noticeably decreasing, a good reason for this could be a leak. If you have a significant leak, the location will be very obvious, so a quick inspection of the aquarium should help in locating the leak. If the leak is not obvious, you may only notice it when you find a wet spot at the location of your aquarium. Even a small damp area could indicate a problem. If you have changed the filter, added new items to your aquarium, or made any other changes, this could have caused the water to leak. Try drying the area and observe if more water escapes. If you see water outside the aquarium again, it is likely a leak. If you suspect you have a leak but cannot find it immediately, you will need to search a bit. Look for metal corners that may have come loose from the glass. Another clue could be sealant that is visibly oozing out at the corners. These are telltale signs that there is a problem with your aquarium. Also, feel around the edges of the aquarium. If you feel damp glass, move your hand up from that spot until you feel the glass is dry. The wet spot closest to the top of the aquarium is likely the leak you are looking for. Once you find the leak or have a spot you believe is where the leak is, you should mark the area with a felt tip pen. This way, you will know exactly where to start your repairs after you have drained the water from your aquarium. Once your repairs are done, the felt tip marks can easily be removed with glass cleaner. Leaks along the seams can be relatively easy to fix since they are usually due to sealing errors, and seams can simply be resealed with silicone. However, if the leak is due to cracked glass, the repair will not be so straightforward. Replacing an entire pane of glass takes much more time and skill. In fact, it is very likely that such a repair can only be carried out by someone with the appropriate experience. If a side or the bottom of your aquarium is cracked, it is very likely that the whole aquarium will fail. Due to the water pressure, the crack will widen, and once the crack becomes large enough, the glass sides of the tank will shatter.

Your horse moves its head in various ways depending on how it feels, and the position of its head signals a range of moods. When your horse holds its head high, it indicates that it is alert and curious. A lowered head can mean several things; it might indicate acceptance of a situation or command, or it could suggest that your horse is feeling down, which would require further examination by your veterinarian. When your horse snakes its head (slightly lowering it and moving its neck side to side), it shows signs of aggression. If possible, remove your horse from what is bothering it; if that cannot be done safely, back away as far as possible until it calms down. Your horse may turn its head to look at its flank, indicating discomfort in the abdominal area. Your horse may swish its tail to chase away flies or insects. Although the natural tail position can vary by breed, there are certain positions that are common across breeds. In addition to shooing away pests, tail swishing can also indicate excitement and serve as a warning sign to other horses to keep their distance. When excited, your horse will swish its tail faster and more aggressively than when just trying to chase off insects. Your horse often lifts its tail when it is happy and alert. For foals, a tail held high over the back signifies either playfulness or alarm. If your horse's tail is tucked down, it may be experiencing discomfort, such as a fly on its underside. Your horse holds its neck in various ways to convey whether it is tense, relaxed, etc. Knowing these different neck positions helps you better understand your horse’s body language. When your horse's neck is extended and the muscles underneath feel loose, it may indicate that it is relaxed and happy. Conversely, if the muscles are tense, your horse is likely feeling stressed and unhappy.

Before you can apply for Japanese citizenship, you must have lived in Japan for at least five consecutive years. You can also obtain Japanese citizenship if you meet one of the following conditions: you have lived in Japan for three or more years and are the child of a Japanese citizen; you were born in Japan and have lived there for at least three consecutive years, and either your father or mother was born in Japan; or you have lived in Japan for ten or more consecutive years. You must not only prove when you lived in Japan, but you also need to provide the dates you left Japan and when you re-entered during that period. This proof can be provided through copies of passports, visa certificates, or other similar official documents. You must be at least 20 years old and be able to demonstrate your coming of age according to the legal standards of your home country. In some countries, the legal age of majority is 18 or 21 years. If you are unsure about the age at which you are considered an adult in your home country, you should consult a lawyer from your home country. You must submit a police clearance certificate proving that you have no criminal record. However, each case is reviewed individually, so you may still obtain Japanese citizenship even with a criminal past. The legal requirement states that you can maintain a secure livelihood either through work or property you own. If you are married and your spouse provides for the family income, this condition is fulfilled. If you are employed and specify your place of employment in your application, immigration officials may visit your workplace to verify that your provided information is accurate. In some countries, you must renounce your previous citizenship before or during the application for Japanese citizenship. Japan does not allow dual citizenship to avoid potential conflicts of interest. However, it is possible to obtain Japanese citizenship without giving up your own if you can demonstrate exceptional circumstances that justify this. Individuals under 20 years old can hold dual citizenship, but they must choose one citizenship before reaching the age of 20. If you believe you meet all or most of the requirements for Japanese citizenship, you should contact the relevant Ministry of Justice in your region in Japan, which will arrange a meeting. The first conversation, which can be conducted either by phone or in person, serves as a preliminary selection. The authority wants to ensure that you meet all or most of the requirements for obtaining Japanese citizenship. If you convince the official that you can proceed with your application, a second conversation will be scheduled. During the second conversation, you will learn about the additional conditions you must fulfill to determine your eligibility for Japanese citizenship. There is no fixed list of requirements. Authorities review each applicant and case individually and create a requirement list based on that. Generally, you must submit the following types of documents: birth certificate, marriage certificate, passport, proof of international travel, employment verification, proof of assets, proof of residence, proof of education (transcripts, diplomas), proof of physical and mental fitness, and proof of no criminal record. During the second conversation, you will be shown a video demonstrating how to integrate and adapt to life in Japan. This video lasts about an hour. After the second meeting, you will receive a list of the specific supporting documents you need to submit, along with a book describing the naturalization requirements. You must read this book and begin gathering the supporting documents, which may take several months. Once you have completed this, you can contact your caseworker at the authority and arrange an application interview. At the end of the second conversation, you will receive the name of your caseworker and your case number. When you believe you have met all the requirements, contact your caseworker and arrange an application interview (everything up to this point has only been preparation). You will now meet with one or more agency officials who will review every detail of your application. If any points are missing or incomplete, you must provide them. It is also possible that this meeting reveals that you need to submit additional documents. After submitting your application, you will be sent home to wait for the outcome. The officials will now review and verify all details of your application. The verification process may also include a visit to your home. Officials are also authorized to question your personal contacts or employers. During the verification process, you may be contacted to provide further information on any aspect of your application. This part of the application process can take several months. If everything is satisfactory to the authorities, you will be contacted for a final conversation. During this meeting, you must sign the required affidavits, and your application will be officially recognized by the authority. The immigration authority will forward your complete citizenship application along with your signed statements to the Ministry of Justice. If the ministry maintains and confirms your documents, you will officially have Japanese citizenship.

If your microwave doesn’t have a turntable, heat the macaroni and cheese in intervals of 45 seconds and turn the bowl in between. Even the most carefully reheated macaroni and cheese can lose some flavor. To jazz it up, sprinkle some Parmesan, salt and pepper, a little butter, or garlic salt on top. For a bit more adventure, you could try it with ketchup, a pinch of cayenne pepper, or even hot sauce. Enjoy your meal!

Shoes in black and nude tones go with almost any outfit, so when in doubt, wear one of these colors! If your outfit has many brown tones, then wear shoes in brown or nude tones instead of black. If you are wearing a striking pattern, combine it with solid-colored shoes. If your shoes are eye-catching, such as having a leopard print, pair them with a solid top or pants. Wear shoes with an interesting texture, like suede, to complement your outfit. If you wear black shoes, combine them with a black belt and a black bag to create a cohesive look. Do the same with accessories in nude and brown tones. Ensure that the accessories match each other! For example, if your belt has a silver buckle, your bag and shoes should also have silver elements. Your jewelry, such as bracelets, necklaces, and earrings, should also coordinate. If your belt has a gold buckle, wear gold earrings with it. A nice pair of sunglasses can elevate almost any outfit! Choose sunglasses that suit your face shape or contrast with the colors of your outfit. For instance, wear a black cat-eye sunglasses for a classic look. Oversized glasses or round lenses are great for a bohemian style. If you like boho or easy glam, stack your rings! Wear your largest ring on the index finger of each hand. Then stack a regular-sized and a midi ring on your ring fingers. Complete the look with two to three midi rings as a contrast on your middle fingers. You don’t have to wear makeup, but it can help you feel more confident and polished if you enjoy it. Apply a light foundation that matches your skin tone. Use a little concealer to cover blemishes and breakouts. Add a touch of rosy blush and mascara to look fresh and naturally made up. If you have oily skin, use a bit of powder to combat shine. Apply lip gloss or lipstick in nude or berry tones. Comb your hair to remove knots. If you have curls, detangle them with your fingers or a wide-toothed comb. Wear your hair down, tie it back from your face, or style short hair with a styling product for shape and definition. Apply a small amount of anti-frizz cream or serum to tame flyaways. If you have little time in the morning, consider getting a simple haircut that is easy to style.

Be careful when running. Choose safe places with many people and as few cars as possible. Select a good time of day for running. Running at night or in the early morning before dawn is much more dangerous than running during the day. You risk being hit by a car or being attacked by someone when fewer people are around. Ensure good visibility for drivers. If you want to run near a road, wear bright, reflective clothing for visibility. You can also use devices like a flashing LED to make yourself more noticeable. Jog with a buddy. Whether you run with a person or just a dog, this is significantly safer. It protects you from unpleasant encounters. Do a test run. Go for a run and see how you feel. Test how far you can go before you feel exhausted. You should have realistic expectations, as this makes success more likely. Don’t forget that you also have to run back. Factor in how long it will take you to return to your starting point. Yes, you may make it to the café down the street – but how will you get back? Gradually and slowly increase the distance. Remember, as you get fitter and can move faster, you will also be able to cover greater distances. Progress slowly. You also train your body better when you run longer, so keep longer distances in mind. Use mapping software. You can use free tools like Google Maps or RunningMap.com to measure the distance run and assess things like elevation changes. Some websites also have a social aspect, allowing you to meet other runners in your area and share and compare routes. Consider the terrain. Changes in road type, terrain, and elevation can be a bigger hurdle than you think. Avoid things like steep hills at the end of a run, as this increases the likelihood of injury. Test the route. If you think you have a good route in mind, try it out before committing to it. You can also choose a few different routes to add some variety.

Men like it when their partner is confident and brave. Take good care of yourself and make an effort to look as good as you feel. Focus on the things that make you special and emphasize those traits. Don’t take him for granted. Let him know how much you appreciate that he stays calm in stressful situations or that he cleaned up the kitchen after dinner. Even if he doesn’t say anything, he will feel good. You should not give up on yourself in a relationship, and he shouldn’t either. If you both remain independent by continuing your hobbies and meeting your own friends, you will have more to talk about and will respect each other better in the long run. As you get to know each other better, don’t forget to ask him what he likes. If he talks about something that makes his eyes light up, remember it and find out more. Then surprise him with a gift that shows you listened well, like inviting him to the exclusive golf club he mentioned. Just because your guy feels like a big, strong man doesn’t mean you have to pretend to be weak. Build him up with compliments so he feels good and let him be chivalrous by holding the door for you. If you boost his ego, he will want to spend more time with you. Just because you are together now doesn’t mean you should stop flirting. In fact, it is very important that you continue doing the cute, flirty things that initially attracted him to you. Gently touch his arm, lean against him while doing the dishes, or look at him in a way that shows you want more than just watching a movie. If he has just gotten used to being with you, you probably shouldn’t start monogramming towels right away. That might scare him off, causing him to pull back. If he sends mixed signals, take a step back and let him come to you.

In order for wood ash to be suitable as tattoo ink, you must completely burn the wood you are using. The ash should be completely black, with no visible traces of the wood's natural color. It must also be completely cooled when you use it. Different types of wood will give you slightly different shades when the ash is used as ink. Lighter wood produces a grayer pigment, while darker wood produces a blacker pigment. Once you have burned your chosen wood to create ash, you need to grind the burned wood. The ash particles should be as fine as possible to create a smooth and easy-to-use ink. To make tattoo ink from wood ash, you need to mix it with a liquid. Some people recommend using distilled water, but this risks bacteria entering your skin when you press the needle in. Instead, use a clear spirit – like vodka or gin – as the liquid base. The alcohol kills bacteria, and the clarity of the alcohol does not change your ink color. Mix your ash with your clear spirit by blending it in a mixer for ten to twenty minutes. The consistency should be muddy – a little thicker than water but thinner than a paste – and should contain no lumps. It is hard to recommend an exact ratio of ash to liquid. It depends on how finely you have ground the ash, the type of wood you are using, and the desired pigmentation of your ink. It is better to add the liquid slowly – you can always add more, but you cannot take any out. If you are creating a larger tattoo, make sure to keep track of the amounts of ash and liquid you are using. You will likely need to mix more than one batch of ink, and knowing the exact measurements will keep the pigment of the ink consistent.

Depending on the device, you may need to connect it to a power source first. This is the B-shaped icon on the right in the menu bar at the top of the screen. This will open a dropdown menu. You may need to restart your computer or update its software if the device does not work.

No matter if you build a trap yourself or buy one, you must ensure that it is humane. After all, you don't want to hurt the kitten you are trying to save. (You also need to be careful not to injure yourself – no one wants to get their finger caught in a trap.) One of the best ways to safely catch a kitten is to lure it into the trap with bait. Canned fish is an effective and inexpensive food you can try. A humane trap does not injure or kill the kitten. If you want to buy a trap, ask your veterinarian for a recommended brand. You can also check pet supply stores or hardware stores. If you want to build the trap yourself, research traps that do not harm or kill the kitten. Use a trap door that closes gently, yet quickly and firmly after the kitten enters. Ask at the hardware store for tips on the right materials. Do not try to catch the kitten at the first sighting. Instead, prepare your trap and place food inside for a few days – while the trap door remains open. This way, the kitten will voluntarily enter the trap later after it learns to associate it with food. You should be as gentle as possible with the kitten. Remember, it does not have much experience with people. Being caught can be a very traumatic experience. Be as calm and gentle as possible when you are near the kitten. It can be frustrating to want to catch a kitten. You must be patient, not only with the kitten but also with yourself. Remember to give yourself enough time to execute your plan. You need to learn about the kitten (its age, what about the mother). This alone takes time. Once you have done that, take a break before you start the actual catching. The more relaxed and secure you are, the smoother everything will go. If using a trap makes you nervous, you do not need to worry. There are other options. You can try to gently "herd" a kitten into an enclosed area. Use the same method you would use to lure the kitten into a trap – food. Once you have lured the kitten into an enclosed area (for example, a corner without an escape route), you can gently direct it into a small transport box. Remember to have a transport box (or even a box with a lid) ready before trying this method. It is possible that you may not need to lure and catch the kitten at all. If you have enough time and patience, you can bond with the kitten enough that it will easily come home with you. To gain the kitten's trust, you need to become a reliable aspect in its life. Feed it regularly at the same time for several days. Be calm and gentle in its presence. If enough time passes (this could be days or weeks), the kitten may accept your proximity without fear.

Unlike classic Microsoft Paint, with Paint 3D you can create your image on a transparent background. However, you cannot directly create an icon file in Paint 3D. Fortunately, you can convert your image with a transparent background into a more satisfactory icon file using ICO Convert. To do this, click on the Windows logo at the bottom left of the screen. Type "paint" and then click on Paint 3D at the top of the Start window. Unlike Microsoft Paint, Paint 3D is only available on Windows 10. Paint 3D was introduced for the first time in Spring 2017 with the Windows 10 Creator's Update. If you do not have Paint 3D, first perform an update of Windows 10. This box-shaped icon opens a sidebar on the right side of the window. The switch will turn blue, indicating that your canvas is now transparent. When the switch is blue, your canvas is already transparent. Proceed on the right side of the window: Click on the dropdown field "Percent" and then in the displayed menu click on Pixels. Replace the value in the "Width" field with 32. Replace the value in the "Height" field with 32. Click at the top right on the slider and move it until your canvas is large enough for you to work with. Click on the brush-shaped tab "Brush" at the top of the window, select a brush, choose a color, reduce the brush size if necessary, and click to draw on the canvas. It shows a folder. This opens a "Save as" window. Type any name for your icon in the "File name" field. In the "Save as type" field, you should see "2D - PNG (*.png)". If not, click on the "Save as type" field and then in the dropdown menu on "2D - PNG (*.png)". Click on a folder on the left of the window (e.g., Desktop). This saves your project as a PNG with a transparent background. Since your saved PNG file cannot be used as an icon, you need to convert it to an icon file using a free website: Go to http://icoconvert.com/ in your computer's browser. Click on "Choose file". Select your PNG file and click on "Open". Click on "Upload". Crop your image as needed, then scroll down and click on "None". Scroll all the way down and click on "Convert ICO". Click on the link "Download your icon" when it appears. Once you have saved the icon, you can assign it to a shortcut on your computer.

Cats with asthma have a very specific gagging position. Generally, this means that the animal crouches down and stretches its neck forward while gagging. Pay attention to whether your cat assumes this position when gagging. If your cat takes this position but then does not expel anything while gagging, it could be a sign of asthma. Although a cat cough may appear as gagging, it will likely sound more wheezy. It can also sound like either "dry" or "wet" coughing, where it seems like your pet is trying to expel mucus but then swallows it again. Your cat may stick its tongue out while coughing. Your cat may appear more "out of breath" than usual. You may even hear wheezing after the animal has run around a bit. If your cat has great difficulty breathing, it may be breathing with its mouth open.

Soundhound can recognize songs that you hum when you don't have a recording of the song. Download the app and open it on your phone. You can either tap the Soundhound icon or ask the question "What is this song?" After that, you can either play a recording of the song or sing it as best as you can. Soundhound also provides additional information about the artist and the album in which the song was released. If you have the Google app installed on your phone, you can activate the Google Assistant by saying "Okay, Google" or by tapping the Google app icon on your phone. When the Google Assistant appears, say "What song is this?" and hold your phone near the sound source. The Google Assistant will automatically recognize the song and provide you with details. You can use the links provided by the app to purchase the song or find it on YouTube. Say "Hey, Siri" to activate Siri on your iPhone or press and hold the Home button on your phone. Then say "What song is this?" while holding your phone near the speakers. Siri will provide you with a link to purchase the song on iTunes. Siri uses the same software as Shazam. Search for the Shazam app in the app store and download it to your phone. Once the app is downloaded, hold your phone up to the speakers and play the song that needs to be recognized. Tap the Shazam button and wait a few seconds for the app to recognize the song. Shazam is compatible with iPhones, Windows phones, and Android devices.

It is not only the smell of food that can trigger your nausea; you also need to look for non-food triggers. According to babycenter.com, a warm or stuffy room, the scent of heavy perfume, a car ride, or even certain visual stimuli like flickering lights can cause nausea. Take note of what triggers your nausea each time it occurs, and you can consciously avoid those triggers in the future. Sudden movements can jolt your stomach and trigger a new wave of nausea, so try to move as slowly and carefully as possible. Take your time getting out of bed in the morning – nibble on a cracker while still in bed, gently move into a sitting position, and stay seated for a few minutes before standing up. Take the whole day slowly and do not overexert yourself. Set your alarm for half an hour earlier than usual to give yourself enough time in the morning. Try placing a small stool or bench in the shower to prevent feelings of dizziness. Sometimes, the simplest solution is to pause and give your body a break. Try lying down, closing your eyes, taking a few deep breaths, and just resting. Many women find sleeping is a great remedy for morning sickness, possibly because their bodies need the rest! If you already have children, consider getting a babysitter, even if it's just for an hour or two, so you can catch up on much-needed sleep and rest. Are you having trouble napping during the day? Try wearing a sleep mask or dark sunglasses to block out bright light. You might think that surfing the web will distract you from morning sickness, but the bright computer screen and subtle strobing effects can actually worsen your nausea. To combat this, try adjusting your screen settings to reduce eye strain. Change the font size to make it larger and bolder, and switch your background color to pink or beige. Take short breaks from the computer as often as possible – stand up and move around or simply close your eyes. Go outside to get some fresh air and exercise. Take deep breaths in through your nose and out through your mouth. Fresh country or sea air is best, but even your garden or a nearby park will work well. If you must stay indoors, try opening a window to let stale air out and allow fresh air to circulate. Nausea can be difficult to ignore, but it can help to find something to distract you – read a magazine, call a friend, or take a short walk. Light exercise, such as yoga or swimming, can also help with nausea, but you should discuss any exercise plans with your doctor first. It’s also important to listen to your body – if you start to feel tired or unwell, it’s time to stop. It’s a good idea to put together a small survival kit for emergencies when you're not at home. Pack a toothbrush and toothpaste, mints, and a clean blouse. You might also want to bring a snack like crackers or pretzels and a plastic bag for situations where you can’t make it to the restroom in time. If it seems like your morning sickness just won’t improve, then see a doctor. Ask about anti-nausea medications that might help relieve your suffering. A small percentage of women develop a severe form of pregnancy vomiting, which is an extreme form of morning sickness and can lead to severe dehydration and weight loss. If you think you might be at risk, contact your doctor immediately. Some anti-nausea medications may not be covered by insurance and can be expensive – keep this in mind before getting a prescription.

If your itching is due to an allergy, your doctor may prescribe antihistamines or allergy pills. Other medications will be used if the cause is an underlying condition, such as kidney disease. Depending on the affected body area and the cause, you may be prescribed a topical corticosteroid cream to be applied directly to the irritated areas. If the itching is very severe, your doctor may also prescribe an oral steroid or other medications to be taken orally or applied locally. Your doctor may also recommend ultraviolet light treatments; certain wavelengths can help control itching. Phototherapy is often used for itching related to jaundice in liver diseases, such as cirrhosis. Most pharmacies sell creams containing only 1% hydrocortisone without a prescription; they can be helpful in the short term while treating the underlying cause. Without a doctor's recommendation, local anesthetics like benzocaine should not be used regularly, as side effects can occur. Do not use such medications, especially in children. Calamine lotion is often used to relieve itching caused by poison ivy and chickenpox. If your itching does not respond to conventional medications or home remedies, you should consult your doctor about less common causes of itching; these can include pinched nerves, psychological conditions such as obsessive-compulsive disorders, or genetic disorders like epidermolysis bullosa. Sometimes, the doctor may even prescribe an antidepressant to help alleviate the itching.

In the "Ollie," you pop the board up and then land safely back on it. In the first part of the trick, you need to get used to placing your back foot on the tail of the board to lift the nose. In the "Manual," you basically move a bit back on the board to raise the nose. Practice moving backward on the board, lifting the nose while maintaining your balance. You can also do this while riding, if you feel confident. Before attempting the "Manual," stand next to the board and practice lifting the nose into the air. Step on the tail with one foot and test how much pressure you need to apply for it to pop up. Stand on the board, bend your knees to shift your weight over the axles, and push your back foot to the end of the board. Step on the tail like in the "Manual" and lift it for the "Ollie." Don't try this while riding at first. You should only attempt the "Ollie" while riding once you have mastered it; otherwise, it can be dangerous and you might fall hard. To pop the board up, you need to simultaneously push your front foot slightly back, jump up, pull your legs to your chest, and push down on the tail with your back foot. This needs to happen in a fluid motion, which can be difficult at first. You have to jump up and off the board while also pushing down on the tail with your rear foot. Jump with your front foot a bit earlier than with your back foot. Imagine you are running sideways and jumping over an object; that's the movement. When the board has popped into the air, you need to level it with your front foot to control it. You must do this shortly after you jump. When the board is level again, press it down to the ground by straightening your legs and land in a riding position on it. The most important thing is to land with your feet and bent knees over the axles. This increases the likelihood that you can ride safely, that your board won't break, and that you will remain uninjured. It's not shameful to bail. If the board isn't level or something doesn't feel right, it's better to land on the ground. When practicing the "Ollie," it's even good to jump off the board and land beside it initially. Once you can do ten "Ollies" in place consecutively, try it while riding. Push off and ride slowly to moderately fast. Crouch down and let the board pop up, just like you did while standing. The "Ollie" is a fundamental trick. Most tricks that involve the board popping up are based on it. More information and articles about tricks can be found in the next section.

The simplest option would be to leave your hair down, but if you want to look a bit more elegant, you can tie the braids into a bun at the top. The more traditional snakehead style would be to wear the hair down. For a slightly fancier and subtler look, wrap the braids into a bun and secure them at the top of your head. Tie small rubber snakes between your braids and secure them with rubber bands if necessary. If you wear your hair down, then wrap one to three snakes around each braid. If you have fewer braids, use three snakes per braid. However, if you have many braids, one snake per braid will be sufficient. Also, wrap snakes between the braids and tie them loosely with a rubber band. Make sure some hang with their heads down and others with their heads up. If you have your hair up, then wrap four to six snakes in each braid. Some snakes should protrude sideways, while others hang down. Secure the hanging snakes by wrapping a piece of wire around a hairpin (the modern variant) and attaching the wire to the snake using a sewing needle. Then, pin the hairpin into your hair, adjusting it so that the snake sits well.

To determine "who's next," there are various methods. For example: the youngest player goes first; or the person who has the next birthday; or you can use a counting rhyme like "Ene Mene Muh" or the classic "Eckstein, Eckstein, everyone must be hidden." Alternatively, simply draw numbers from a hat, and the "1" starts. If one person is older than all others, they are a natural choice. The younger you are, the faster you might get frustrated if others are well hidden. Older individuals have a longer attention span and can think unconventionally more easily than their younger counterparts. Once it's determined who starts, that person stays at the starting point and begins counting loudly and at a steady pace up to 10. Or 20, 50, or 100 – or they can recite a rhyme or sing a song. Anything to kill some time until everyone else has hidden. Agree beforehand on what it will be, so everyone knows how much time they have. Make sure the person doesn’t cheat! The person who is "it" must have their eyes closed, hands over their eyes, and stand in a corner. No peeking! All players who are not "it" run off and hide quietly from the seeker. The person who is "it" cannot see where you hide. Be as quiet as possible; otherwise, the seeker may hear where you are hiding or in which direction you are. Once you find a good hiding spot, remain quiet and still. Once you are hidden, you must not give yourself away! If you make noise, even the best hiding place won't conceal you. When the person who is "it" finishes counting, they shout “1-2-3, I’m coming!” Now they must try to find all the other players. Both your eyes and ears are important, seeker! If you find someone, clearly mark them. Players who are hiding may change their position or leave their hiding place if they wish. For example, it’s a good idea to change positions and hide in a place the seeker has already searched. That’s strategy! If some of the hidden players are not found after a certain time or do not return to the starting point, the person who is "it" should give the "all clear" signal. They might call out something like “Everyone is free.” Then it’s safe for the remaining players to come out. The first person found is "it" for the next round. You can play so that only one person needs to be found for a new round to start, or everyone must be found. You can also introduce a time limit. If the seeker has not found everyone within the time limit after 3 attempts, they still switch roles. Give everyone a chance to hide!

Milk is extremely effective when it comes to relieving the burning sensation from spicy food. The reason for this is the casein it contains, a special protein in milk. Casein breaks down the bonds that capsaicin, the substance that causes the burning sensation, forms on your receptors. You can also soothe your tongue with a large sip of tomato juice, orange juice, or lemon juice. These juices neutralize the pH level of the spicy food, providing relief. Capsaicin can be dissolved by alcohol, but only if the alcohol is relatively strong. If you are old enough and the situation allows, you can take a sip of liquor such as tequila, rum, or vodka to get rid of the burning on your tongue. Do not try to alleviate the burning with beer. Beer does not work in this case because it has too much water and too little alcohol. A glass of ice water may seem like a good solution for your burning mouth, but it can worsen the pain. Capsaicin is a natural oil, and oil and water do not mix. Therefore, water will not change how capsaicin affects your membranes. It may even exacerbate your misery by further spreading the capsaicin in your mouth.

Apply sunscreen with at least SPF 30 every day, even if it's cloudy or cold outside. UVA and UVB rays lead to wrinkles, dryness, and sagging skin. Reapply sunscreen multiple times throughout the day. Before you shower, use a loofah to wipe your body, which removes dead skin cells. Make sure to wipe your entire body. Use a pumice stone in the shower to scrub your feet and other rough skin areas, like your elbows. For the rest of your body, use a body brush to gently scrub your skin. At the end of your shower, turn the water as cold as you can tolerate to close your pores. When you come out of the shower, dry your body by patting it with a towel. Avoid aggressively rubbing your skin with the towel. After patting your skin dry, apply a gentle moisturizer all over your body. Don't forget the soles of your feet, your elbows, and your hands.

Buy feed that is specifically tailored to the needs of laying hens. The feed should have a high content of plant fats and proteins. Remember that additional starch (from kitchen scraps or grains) must be supplemented with more protein because it lowers the average protein content of the diet. If your hens have a calcium deficiency, they will not produce strong eggshells. If the shells are weak and break when a hen sits on or steps on the egg, the hen will eat the damaged egg. Once she discovers that the egg contains proteins and fats, and important calcium in the shell, she will begin to break the egg and intentionally eat it. Other hens will observe her behavior and follow her example. Ground oyster shells or limestone are a great source of calcium for your hens. Mix one kilogram of this powder with 45 kilograms of feed or provide your hens with an additional feeder from which they can eat. Offer your hens a dish of whole milk over several days to increase their calcium intake. Avoid using eggshells as a calcium source for your hens, as they may recognize or smell them and may start eating their eggs. If you choose this method, you should crush the shells into tiny pieces so that the hens cannot recognize what they are eating. You may notice that eggshells are softer in warm weather. Hens may be less able to store calcium in hot weather. Increase the additional dose of calcium in the feed on warm days. Even if the hens have enough calcium available, a lack of water can cause them to eat the fluid from the eggs. Hens need more water than most other birds, so you should ensure they always have fresh, clean drinking water. You can add a vitamin supplement to the water that improves calcium absorption in your hens.

One of the best things about hot chocolate pancakes is the variety of ways you can top them with different sauces and toppings, allowing you to transform even simple pancakes into a fantastic breakfast buffet. In a pot or a water bath over low heat, whisk together the chocolate chips and cream. Turn off the heat and let the fudge sauce cool until it's lukewarm. It is best to start rooting your hibiscus cuttings during the summer months (May, June, and July). Note that not all cuttings will develop roots, so you should always plant more cuttings than you need. You can usually expect that one-third or at best half of all cuttings will develop into viable plants. Take a 12 cm long shoot from your garden yew. Choose new, healthy shoots that are 12 cm long and cut them at a 45-degree angle. The shoots should not be woody but soft and green, yet relatively robust. They must be new this year's shoots and not old woody ones. Remove the lower leaves from the shoots. Dip the cut end of the shoots in rooting hormones or cover them with rooting powder. Now you need to decide how you want to root your cuttings, either in compost soil or in water. If you want to start rooting your cuttings in compost soil, insert the stems about 4 to 5 cm deep into a pot filled with moist compost soil. It is best to use compost soil or a mixture that is half compost soil and half sand. Cover the pot either with a plastic bag or use an inverted clear plastic bottle with the spout cut off to create a mini greenhouse. If you use a plastic bag, make sure it does not touch the seedlings; you can hold the bag up with a small stick if necessary. Keep the potted cuttings moist and do not place them directly in the sun. They should start to root after about a month or two. Some gardeners do not use compost soil; they prefer to place their cuttings in a clear glass or plastic container with water to allow roots to form. If you do it this way, you can observe the roots developing. Fill the glass or plastic container with 5 cm of water, place your cutting inside, and set it in a bright location, but not directly in the sun. Cover it with a plastic bag and mist it daily with water from a spray bottle. It is important to place each cutting in a separate container to prevent bacteria buildup. Do this even if you are preparing multiple cuttings as recommended, so you have enough in case they do not root. If you place your hibiscus cuttings in water, remember to change the water regularly: every two to three days is advisable. It is recommended to use rainwater if possible. If you do not collect rainwater in your garden and do not have access to a water source, you could let tap water sit in a jug for 24 hours. This will remove some chlorine from the tap water. However, this is not strictly necessary, and your cuttings could also root in tap water. Once you see new roots that are 2.5 to 5 cm long, plant the cutting in moist compost soil. They should not be exposed to direct sunlight for a few months until the roots are better established.

It can often be difficult to accept this, but some friendships are not worth saving. If your friend has consistently treated you poorly or you feel bad in their presence, it may be time to say goodbye. Friends should treat each other kindly, encourage one another, respect each other, and have understanding. If either of you is unable to do this, then you probably do not have a healthy friendship. If you have to pretend to be someone else when you are around this friend, it is a sure sign of a toxic friendship. If you always have to walk on eggshells around them, it is likely not a good friendship. If your friend constantly criticizes your personality, then you are in a toxic relationship. A good friend gives criticism compassionately. In a healthy, balanced friendship, both sides maintain contact with each other. However, if your friend never calls or texts you first, or if all plans are always initiated by you, there may be an imbalance in your friendship. With a toxic friend, you may constantly have to fight for their attention and affection. A good friend accepts you as you are and takes time for you—without exception. Toxic people often try to make you put aside your own problems to take care of theirs. Think about how you felt in the presence of this person, and ask yourself whether being friends with them was truly helpful and beneficial. You should feel that you can fundamentally trust your friend. You should also feel that you are there for each other. Your friend should support you on your path, and you should do the same for them. If you conclude that your friendship is not worth your efforts, then you must completely sever ties with this person. Proceed decisively and directly. Don’t just block their number and avoid them forever—end your friendship in person to draw a line. You could say something like, “I’ve been thinking about our friendship, and I believe I need a break. I don’t like the way I feel when we’re together. I think I need to sort some things out for myself.”

Before you cut people out of your life, you should be sure to do it for the right reasons. Are you stressed? Are your friends stressed? If so, it might not be a good time. However, if this has been going on for a while and you simply no longer feel comfortable in their presence, it is likely the right decision. Life is too short to spend time with people who do not bring out the best in us. Knowing exactly why you no longer want to maintain the friendship will help you explain to the other person or people why you want to end the relationship. If you are convinced of your arguments, it becomes much harder to start a discussion and get angry. Do not act out of a bad mood or anger. If you are considering ending the friendship, sleep on it. If your feelings have not changed the next day, it is probably wise to go through with your decision. It may be hard at first to express your true feelings about the broken friendship, but in the long run, it is the kindest thing you can do in this situation. It can also save you further stress by declaring the friendship over. Bring up the topic gently. Be careful not to blame the other person or accuse them of having an unbearable character. This is also somewhat about you. For example, you could say something like: "I don’t know how you see the situation, but I am open to hearing your thoughts. However, it is important for you to understand that I feel our friendship is no longer going well. I increasingly notice that we have developed in different directions (drifted apart, constantly bickering, bringing each other down, etc.), and after thinking about it carefully, I believe we can no longer save our relationship. I think we should see each other less and honestly admit what has happened to our friendship." Be aware that you should remain objective and, as far as possible, not assign blame if you specify concrete reasons for the end of your friendship. As soon as you give a reason directly related to the character or actions of the other person, you create room for the other person to promise to change. You run the risk of being drawn into a discussion from which it is difficult to extricate yourself. Focus on yourself and how you feel—things that no one can influence. To avoid a defensive response, keep your arguments neutral. You want to walk away from the situation with your head held high. Do not say anything negative about your friend's character; that leads to a defensive stance and can make you seem mean and petty. If that happens, you might feel compelled to "repair" the friendship, and it could take several months before you feel strong enough to try to end the relationship again. Criticize how you feel in the friendship rather than addressing your friend's annoying habits. You do not want her to feel attacked—that can lead to nothing good (especially if you have mutual friends). Be aware that what you say will likely be interpreted negatively. This is completely human and a way to cope with the pain. Therefore, keep your statements simple, kind, and clear. This is not about being "convinced" that the friendship still makes sense, but about showing the decency to be willing to listen. You can summarize your friend's description and then reiterate that you still feel the friendship has run its course. This conversation will likely lead to a lot of sadness, pain, or even anger from your friend. Be prepared to acknowledge those feelings, but do not let them tempt you to sweep the problems under the rug. Do not let yourself be insulted; angry reactions are a sign that a break is needed. If there is no closure, that is okay. You have done what you needed to do. If your friend becomes angry during the conversation, do not feel compelled to explain your views. Simply repeat that you do not want a close friendship anymore. Emotions will run high, so it is important to remain as consistent as possible. In some cases, both of you may realize that your friendship has been going nowhere for some time. It is very likely that your friend has the same feelings and will be glad that you shared them so honestly—so give it a try. You should not be stuck in a friendship that you are not interested in. Since you have dealt with the situation openly and honestly, you both know where things stand. It will be easier for both of you to interact in the future if that should happen. However, if that is not possible, the next part discusses the possibility of ending a friendship indirectly and passively.

Organic hypoglycemia is caused by health issues such as liver or kidney diseases, certain tumors, or hormone deficiencies. The treatment involves addressing the underlying cause. Hypoglycemia can also be caused by some medications, especially those used to treat diabetes. Do not change your diet until a doctor has ruled out other reasons and diagnosed you with reactive hypoglycemia. Your new meal plan should meet the recommendations for calories, proteins, minerals, and vitamins for a healthy adult. They can guide you on adding or removing foods from your diet and help you plan the content of your meals and snacks. Inform others of your diagnosis. Everyone can watch for symptoms such as anxiety, irritability, hunger, sweating, shakiness, rapid heartbeat, fatigue, tingling around the mouth, dizziness, and hot flashes. Break your diet and consume sugary foods. The goal is to bring your blood sugar back to a normal range as soon as possible. Let friends, family, and colleagues help you seek medical assistance if you develop symptoms of worsening hypoglycemia, which include confusion, abnormal behavior, blurred vision, seizures, and loss of consciousness. Inform them that you may slur your words and exhibit clumsy movements similar to those of an intoxicated person. You can become symptomatic for two reasons. Your body may begin inappropriately lowering your blood sugar to unusually low levels after you digest food. In response to this stress, your body releases a surge of adrenaline, causing a fight-or-flight response. Additionally, your body is deprived of its primary energy source, glucose. The brain is very sensitive to this deficiency. You may be unable to perform normal tasks, and your mental state (how you think) or level of consciousness (how alert you are) may change.

Knowing what you value can provide insights into who you are inside. Many values are based on your personal experiences, and some change as you learn more about yourself. Sometimes values are hard to identify because the term and concept are abstract and often vague. Your values are your beliefs and ideals upon which you base your choices in life. Identifying and defining your values brings you closer to recognizing who you are and what is important to you. To explore your values, you need to spend time reflecting and analyzing what is important to you and which values make you who you are. Start identifying your values by writing down your answers to the following questions: Identify two people you admire the most. What qualities of theirs do you admire? What makes that person admirable to you? If you could only have three possessions for the rest of your life, which would they be? Why? What topics, events, or hobbies are you passionate about? Why are these things important to you? What about these things ignites your passion? What was the event where you felt the most complete and fulfilled? What about that time gave you that feeling? Why? You should slowly get an idea of what is important to you and what you value. Try to group these ideas, moments, or things into core values to get a better sense of your core beliefs and ideals. Examples of core values include courtesy, honesty, optimism, contentment, friendship, achievement, faith, kindness, justice, trust, and peace. Use these core values to understand and know yourself better. These values should help you make choices and identify what is important to you. By analyzing yourself this way, you are much closer to unleashing your true self. You may have several groups of values. This is normal, as people are complex and feel many different things. For instance, you may value honesty, faith, competence, and self-confidence—values that may not necessarily group together. But these traits show you the types of situations and people you value around you, as well as the qualities you are likely striving for yourself.
