Find a place where you enjoy spending several hours and that has a high likelihood of catching fish. Public lakes, rivers, and ponds are good choices. Talk to anglers at your local sports store and ask them about good spots. Many public parks stock fish in ponds, where everyone can fish, making it relatively easy to learn. However, these spots are often very crowded and dirty. Never crowd other anglers at their spot. Secluded spots at ponds or dams outside of cities are a good choice. When searching for a good spot in the woods, make sure you don’t trespass on private property or go where fishing is not allowed. If you live by the coast, deep-sea fishing is a good option, but you need a special fishing license and equipment for saltwater fish. The fishing methods are quite similar. Some newspapers have special reports on fishing that list locations and what fish can be found there, as well as suitable bait. You can also ask at fishing shops, harbors, and camping supply stores. Catfish are common in the rivers and lakes of the USA. Spotted catfish, blue catfish, and flathead catfish are often caught for consumption. You can find them in deeper waters at the mouths of larger streams and rivers. Look for undercuts and overhangs, as catfish like to hang out there but will swim to deeper water when it gets warm. Want to catch an alligator gar but live in New York? Trying to do that in the East River may be difficult. If you want to catch specific fish on a fishing trip, your journey should lead you to where those fish naturally occur. The Great Lakes have American walleye and many species of pike. Lake Huron is known for these often large fish. In the south, alligator and grass pike can be found in the swamp regions, along with flounder and perch. The Henderson Swamp in Baton Rouge is a great spot for pike, and Lake Pontchartrain has all kinds of species. In the northwest, rainbow trout are widespread, identifiable by their reddish or pink stripes from gills to tail. There are also sunfish and various species of walleye. Once you’ve chosen a body of water and want to find out what fish are there, throw in some small food pieces and wait a few minutes. Rewarding catches spend the day in deep water and come up to feed in shallower areas, but they don’t stay there long. You should look for spots where they come up to feed before diving back down. Look for reeds and tree areas in lakes near steep banks. Insects usually gather at undercuts and small channels, making them good feeding grounds for fish. Shell beds are known for having catfish. Most freshwater fish are crepuscular, feeding at dawn and dusk, making these the best times for fishing. If you’re an early riser, set off before sunrise and enjoy your morning fishing. If the thought of setting your alarm for 4:30 a.m. is dreadful, fish in the early evening. Check with agency websites or ask someone in the park administration about the cleanliness of the water and whether you can safely eat your catch. If you don’t plan to eat the fish, you can simply release it.

When you are lying on your back, turn onto your stomach. Your legs should be stretched straight behind you. Your palms should be flat on the ground or under your shoulders. Your elbows are pointing up. Push the upper half of your body off the ground. It is similar to a push-up, but you are only lifting the upper body, not the hips and legs. Hold this position for about 30 seconds and then lower yourself back down to the ground. Repeat this three to five times or more if you like. You can repeat this exercise multiple times a day.

A tasteful compliment about a boy's appearance is one thing. To shock someone with rude or suggestive comments about their body is quite another. Even if many boys do not show it, they can react vulnerably when you objectify them. No boy should feel like a piece of meat. Although this is advice often given to men regarding their views on women, it applies the other way around as well. Someone is objectified when you make a person's appearance representative of their entire being, especially when those traits are irrelevant in the situation. Simply put, because you should not hurt a boy's feelings, you should not objectify him. There is another reason for this: it could get you into trouble. In fact, creepy comments or compliments can be considered harassment, which can be a serious violation in school or at work and can be harshly punished. There are many contexts where compliments are appropriate, so avoid choosing inappropriate topics. Generally, do not compliment very personal things or emotional topics—unless you are very familiar with each other. This is particularly true when others are present. It might be okay to discuss personal topics face-to-face, but it is better not to do so in front of his friends. What constitutes an inappropriate compliment can vary from place to place. For example, it may be inappropriate to compliment a man about his wife. Your compliments should always aim to uplift the boy. You should not put him down behind his back to feel better at his expense. Do not make ambiguous compliments, meaning those that contain a barely concealed insult or are actually a compliment for yourself. They are not only mean but also usually obvious and can make you look foolish in a social situation. Here is an example of an ambiguous compliment: "Hey, you got a new T-shirt? You look slimmer in it." It seems like a compliment, but you are implying that he usually looks fat. Research suggests that people perceive these comments as ambiguous when they feel that the one giving the compliment knows what is considered normal. Do not use canned phrases. Funny standard phrases can be amusing when you are just joking around, but they are terrible when you want to give someone a sincere compliment. Remember that the best compliments are honest. If this person is not on your mind all day, then you are likely ruining your chances with canned phrases. Do not compliment things you are not entirely sure about. If you are wrong with an assumption, you could offend him or touch a sensitive nerve. Therefore, it is usually better to play it safe and wait. Here are a few things that could be "dangerous" and where caution is warranted: His appearance has recently changed (e.g., he has lost a lot of weight in a short time). You have not seen him for a long time and do not know how his life has changed. If you do not know what his relationship status is. If you are unsure how he feels about current events (e.g., in politics, etc.).

For example, if you are embroidering jeans, you should use thicker thread and a larger needle. To create personal designs, choose a fabric paint that you would like to use on jeans, a jacket, or a shirt. Use a brush or a sponge brush to paint with the fabric paint on the clothing, either using a stencil as a pattern or freehand. You could cut out a small heart stencil from paper and use it to fill a denim jacket with hearts. For a freestyle option, use different fabric colors and a thin brush to create an image or design (like a dog, a flower, or a fruit) on a shirt pocket. You can also buy fabric paints in bottles that come in a squeeze form. You can sew two pieces of decorative ribbon onto a backless sweater. This allows you to tie the ribbon together to form a bow. You can also sew bows onto a T-shirt or jacket pocket, or on the belt loops of shorts or pants. Cut a slit where the new zipper should go to add more style to your outfits and make your clothing easier to put on. Now you just need to align the zipper to the cut edges and sew it on. Add a zipper at the bottom of each leg of tight jeans to make it easier to put them on and take them off. Insert a black or chunky zipper into a flowing shirt to give it more flair. Cut out a square from a fabric you like and sew it on the front of a plain shirt to personalize it. You can also cut pieces from cool fabric in different shapes, like squares, hearts, or stars. Sew them on as patches onto jackets or pants. For example, cut out two hearts from a red velvet fabric. Sew one heart onto each sleeve of a jacket to create unique elbow patches. Folding over the cut or frayed edges of a patch or piece of fabric before sewing it onto your clothing gives it a cleaner look. If you have a monogram machine, you can use it to add your personal monogram to a piece of clothing and make it your own. If you feel confident, you can also hand-stitch your initials onto your clothing. There are also places where you can take your clothing to have it monogrammed by a professional. Do a quick internet search to find one near you. You can buy iron-on images that are already designed and can be ironed onto your clothing at a craft store or online. Follow the instructions on the image to determine how long you need to iron the design, as well as how to wash and treat the clothing. You can also create your own iron-on image by printing a special design onto transfer paper with your printer. You can coordinate the color of thick lace with a tank top and sew it on to create sleeves. Adding a white lace trim to the bottom of shorts also creates a personalized look. If you have holes or slits in your jeans, try sewing lace on the inside where the slits are. This adds style to your outfit. Use a thread color that matches the lace. You can buy materials to create a leather or fabric belt. Choose a design you like and measure your waist to ensure the belt fits properly. You can also buy custom-embossed leather belts that look unique.

Although exercise alone does not lead to weight loss, it helps support your weight loss efforts when you incorporate regular physical activity. Aim to be active for at least 150 minutes each week. Aerobic activities can include sports like dancing, hiking, jogging, or cycling. Be cautious of the calorie estimates on cardio machines; the numbers listed may not accurately reflect your height, weight, or gender. Resistance training is a great complement to cardiovascular activity for your weight loss. By building more muscle mass, you increase your metabolism and burn more calories overall. It is recommended to include two days of strength training each week. Strength training includes activities such as weightlifting, Pilates, or isometric exercises like push-ups or sit-ups. Scheduling one or two sessions with a personal trainer could be a good idea, especially if you are unfamiliar with certain exercises or looking for a workout program to support your new weight loss regimen. A personal trainer can help you create a workout program that is progressive, time-structured, and suited to your abilities/goals. Many gyms offer a free or discounted session with a personal trainer when you join or as part of your membership. A session with a personal trainer can be expensive, but you may only need one or two sessions to learn a program or understand how to use the equipment.

The method of dropping, covering, and holding is related to the famous "Drop, Cover, Roll" method for fire. Although it is not the only method to protect oneself during an earthquake inside a building, it is the one recommended by the U.S. Emergency Management Agency and the American Red Cross. Strong earthquakes occur with little to no warning; therefore, it is advised to drop to the ground as soon as it happens. A small earthquake can quickly escalate into a large one; caution is better than regret. Go under a sturdy table or another piece of furniture. If possible, stay away from glass, windows, exterior doors, walls, and anything that could fall, such as lamps or furniture. If there is no table or desk nearby, cover your face and head with your arms and crouch in a corner inside the building. Here’s what you should not do: run outside. You are far more likely to get injured trying to escape the building than if you stay where you are. Heading towards a doorframe is also a myth; you are safer under a table than under a doorframe, especially in modern homes. Do not run to another room to get under a table or furniture; the ground may shake, and debris could fall. Hold onto any surface or board under which you are hiding and wait for the shaking to stop. If you cannot find a surface to hide under, continue to protect your head with your arms and crouch down as far as possible. Hold on and protect your head with a pillow, unless you are under a very heavy lamp that could fall; in that case, move to the next safe location. Many injuries occur when people leave their bed and walk barefoot over broken glass. Research has shown that many injuries are caused by people trying to move to another place within a building or trying to get outside. Be cautious when you do go outside. Walk, don’t run, in case there are strong aftershocks. Gather in an area without wires, buildings, or cracks in the ground. Do not use elevators to exit; the power may go out, and you could get trapped. The best way is to use the stairs if they are clear.

Make sure to turn off the heater and/or the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system before opening it. Normally, the filter should come out fairly easily. If it is not a disposable filter, it needs to be cleaned. First, remove dirt and loose particles. Generally, mild soap and tap water can be used to rinse and wash the filter. If that applies to yours, take the old filter to a hardware store or an appliance store (or write down the size and/or model number) and buy a replacement filter of the same type. Slide the filter back into the heater so that it fits snugly. Then close the access door or reattach the heater's front panel using the hooks or screws. If the filter does not seem to fit properly, make sure it is not blocked by dirt or debris. If you have a new filter that seemingly does not fit correctly, double-check that you purchased the right type or size. Heater filters need to be cleaned or replaced three to four times a year. When dry, dead skin cells accumulate on your lips, they can appear paler than usual. To restore the naturally rosy tone, you need to exfoliate your lips to reveal the fresh skin underneath. This can easily be done with a homemade lip scrub, for which you likely already have the ingredients at home. Here’s how: Mix one teaspoon of sugar with one teaspoon of honey (or olive oil if you don’t have honey on hand). Scrub your lips with the mixture in circular motions. Rinse your lips and repeat the treatment until you no longer notice dry flakes. If they are very flaky and a simple scrub isn’t enough, you can brush them with a soft toothbrush. Cover them with petroleum jelly, moisten the toothbrush with warm water, and gently scrub your lips in circular motions. You should scrub each area for 20 to 30 seconds before moving on to the next. When you’re done, your lips should be as good as new. Now that you’ve revealed the natural reddish color, the next step is to use a serum or balm to keep them moisturized. If you let the serum sit overnight, you’ll see even better results and wake up with soft, pink lips. Look for a balm or serum containing moisturizing ingredients like oils and a substance that can create a protective barrier like wax or ceramide. Your cheeks will turn red if you pinch them, and you can also improve circulation in your lips to bring out their natural red color and make them look fuller. You can buy a so-called "plumper," but you can also give your lips more natural volume with homemade mixtures. Try these methods: Mix a pinch of cinnamon or cayenne pepper with a good dollop of olive oil. Apply the mixture to your lips, leave it on for a maximum of one minute, and then rinse it off. Mix five drops of peppermint extract with half a teaspoon of olive oil. Apply the mixture to your lips and let it sit for five minutes before rinsing it off. Good care is essential for a pretty, natural color. When your lips become dry, they will also appear pale and dull again. Use a good lip balm to prevent dryness. You can even make your own lip balm with the following method: Melt one tablespoon of beeswax with three tablespoons of coconut oil. Add a few drops of your favorite essential oil, such as peppermint oil, which also helps make your lips look fuller. Pour the mixture into a tube and let it harden before using the balm.

After 24 hours, the swelling will slowly decrease if you have properly elevated and cooled your toe. You can then stabilize it by buddy taping it to the adjacent toe. Place a cotton ball between your little toe and the neighboring toe. Wrap medical tape around the little toe and connect it to the adjacent toe. Make sure the tape is snug on your toes without cutting off circulation. It should be tight enough to provide some support to the broken toe. You should change the cotton ball once a day and re-tape the toes each time to keep the area clean and stable. Continue this until the swelling subsides and your toe heals. Once the swelling has gone down, you should wear shoes with a sturdy, comfortable sole to protect your toe. If you can wear comfortable shoes without irritating your broken toe, it is likely safe to start walking. Take it slow and only walk for short periods. You don’t want to put too much pressure or strain on your healing toe. Your toe may feel sore or stiff while walking, but this should improve quickly once you start stretching it and it becomes stronger. After walking, you should check your toe for swelling. If it appears swollen or irritated, you should cool it with an ice pack for 20 minutes every hour and elevate it.

Some rice cookers have a removable bowl or pot, while others require pouring the rice directly into the cooker. Usually, there is a measuring cup included with the rice cooker (holding 180 ml), or you can use an extra measuring cup for that purpose. One cup (240 ml) of uncooked rice yields about one and a half to three cups (360 – 720 ml) of cooked rice, depending on the variety. Therefore, make sure there is enough space in the rice cooker to prevent overflow. Most rice cooker instructions recommend using cold water. The top line should include the salutation you have chosen, followed by the recipient's name. Where possible, use a polite form for the person, such as Mr., Mrs., or Dr., followed by their first and last name. Typically, you should place a comma after the salutation. In formal letters, you may also choose a colon, but this is generally considered too formal for emails, even for formal emails. A comma is usually sufficient, although you should consider a colon if you are drafting a cover letter in an email. The salutation should be on its own line at the top, so when you finish it, you must hit the enter key to continue on the next line. If you are using line breaks instead of indenting for new paragraphs, you need a blank line between the salutation and the first paragraph. If you are writing to someone for the first time, you should introduce yourself first, even if you know the person in real life. By introducing yourself to the recipient, you encourage them to continue reading. You might write, for example, "My name is Jessica Hills, and I am the marketing manager at XYZ Company." You can also include how you know the recipient: "My name is Robert Smith, and I am also taking your marketing course (Marketing 101 every Tuesday and Thursday at noon)." If you already know the person and there has been previous email communication, you can use the introductory sentence as a greeting. For example, you might write, "Thank you for the quick response," or "I hope you are doing well." In most formal emails, you need to get to the point quickly. This means that your first or second sentence should outline the reason for the email to the recipient. Keep in mind that you should describe your intentions as succinctly as possible. For instance, you could write, "I would like to ask you for support with a marketing issue," or "I am writing to you because I am having difficulties in the course, and I wanted to ask for recommendations regarding additional reading material that might help me."

If you speak too quickly, listeners often have trouble following along. Words sound unclear because they are spoken too fast, and the speaker's tongue cannot keep up. Read aloud and focus on the content, slow down your speech to emphasize important points, and speed up a bit when it gets exciting. Children's books are great for this because they emphasize emotions and have simple writing. You can also try recording yourself when you speak aloud and then determine how many words you speak per minute (W/min.): A normal rate is between 90 and 120 words per minute. Read aloud again at a slower or more moderate pace and now focus on punctuation. Pause at commas and at the end of sentences, using the end of a paragraph to take a breath. Try to incorporate these intentional pauses into your speech so that your listeners have time to understand what you've said and you do not stumble or mispronounce. If you experience unintentional pauses where you need to take a deep breath, you can seek help in courses that reduce the fear of public speaking. There is a special technique to project your voice into the room or to speak louder without sounding hoarse or flat. Look in the mirror and place your hand on your stomach, then breathe deeply in and out. Breathe with your diaphragm below your stomach and not from the upper part of your lungs. If your shoulders stay level during this exercise, you are doing it correctly. Maintain this type of breathing while greeting yourself in the mirror and gradually move further away from the mirror. Or try to speak louder without your voice sounding forced or scratchy. Focus on this exercise when you are asked to speak louder or when you are repeatedly asked to repeat what you said. This exercise is also very helpful when you need to give a presentation.

If you don’t have olive oil, coconut oil, palm oil, avocado oil, or butter will work too. Sauté for eight minutes over low heat. It will start to simmer and smell good. Stir the vegetables occasionally, about once a minute. Sauté the vegetables for another five minutes on low heat. You know the vegetables are done when they are soft and fragrant. The vegetables should not turn dark brown. Stir the vegetables occasionally with a long wooden spoon or a metal stirring stick. Twice a minute should be sufficient. If the vegetables get very hot and are constantly sizzling, it means they are frying. Turn down the heat if this happens. Turn the heat up if the vegetables are not sizzling at all. Stir them into the remaining vegetables. Then turn the heat to high so the vegetables start to simmer. When the soup begins to boil, reduce the heat slightly. You need to keep an eye on the soup to ensure it doesn’t go beyond a simmer. Set the heat to medium or low when the soup is boiling. The soup should bubble lightly but not boil vigorously. If you had turned down the heat, you might be able to turn it back up to medium or high to get it simmering again. After 25 to 30 minutes, the potatoes and carrots should be soft. If you can easily pierce a piece of potato or carrot with a fork without hitting a firm spot, your soup is ready. Stir the soup well after adding each spice. Taste the soup. Start with just one teaspoon of each spice, including salt and pepper. Then add more as needed. Be careful, as it is much easier to add seasoning to a soup than to take it out. If you want to season the soup further, you can add more spices, such as fresh or dried oregano, thyme, or parsley. A dried Italian seasoning mix or poultry seasoning are also good additions. Spices like cayenne pepper will make the soup spicy. Ladle the soup carefully into bowls. Remember, it is very hot. Enjoy your meal.

It's best to snap your fingers against the baby's foot. If there is no reaction and someone is nearby, ask them to call emergency services while you proceed to the next step. If you are alone with the baby, follow the steps below for two minutes (to provide immediate first aid) before calling emergency services. Whether the baby is breathing or not should determine your next steps: If the baby is coughing or gagging during the choking incident, allow it to continue to cough and gag independently. Coughing and gagging are good signs, indicating that the airways are only partially blocked. If the baby is not coughing, you must attempt to clear the airway by performing back blows and/or the Heimlich maneuver. Check the breathing again and this time place your index and middle fingers on the inside of the baby's upper arm, between the elbow and shoulder. If the baby is breathing and has a pulse, place its body in the recovery position. If you cannot detect a pulse or breathing, continue with the next steps to perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), which is a combination of compressions and rescue breaths.

Powder stains are relatively easy to wash out of clothing, but they can also be easily rubbed in! Do not try to brush or wipe off the powder. The safest method to remove excess powder is to blow it off, either with your mouth or with a hairdryer on a low setting. With a small amount of spilled powder, a puff of air may be enough to completely remove the scattered makeup. If the powder has already been rubbed into your garment, you may need to wash the stain out. For powder foundations, a gentle dish soap or hand soap should work well. Apply one or two drops of soap directly onto the stain. If you are concerned about how the soap will affect your garment, test it first on an inconspicuous area. Dampen a clean sponge or washcloth and then wring out the excess water. Gently rub the stain to work in the soap and remove the powder. Rinse the cloth or sponge and repeat to remove the soap. Carefully dab the area with a dry towel after treating the stain. Be careful not to rub the garment, as this could damage the fabric or rub any remaining makeup in further. Wash the garment as usual after treating the stain. Follow the instructions on the label to avoid damaging the garment.

First, you should find out how your voice currently sounds. The individual voice profile consists of six main categories: Volume: How loud do you speak? Articulation: Do you speak clearly or mumble? Voice quality: Is your voice nasal, blocked, or scratchy? General pitch: Do you speak in a shrill, high voice or a low voice? Pitch deviation: Do you speak in a monotone voice? Speed: Do you speak quickly or slowly? To better understand your voice, you need to record it and listen to it. Many people don’t like listening to their own voice, and it may not be a pleasant experience for you either. However, it is important to realize that others perceive your voice the same way. You can record your voice using audio software like Garageband and then listen to it to identify the details that make up your voice profile, including your volume, articulation, quality, deviation, and speed. When you record your voice and then listen to the recording, you get an insightful, objective impression of how it is perceived by others. Pay attention to the weaknesses in your voice, such as mumbling, filler words, nasal sounds, etc. Write down everything that stands out to you. Go through your recordings and the weaknesses. Then think about how you would like to change your voice. Not everyone has the same goals regarding their voice. For example, women with a particularly deep and scratchy voice may wish for a higher pitch and a softer voice quality, while men with a high pitch and faster speaking style may prefer to speak slower and in a deeper pitch.

Suicidal thoughts are often accompanied by many emotional changes; the following changes are common warning signs: extreme mood swings, feelings of loneliness and isolation even in the presence of others, feelings of worthlessness, shame, guilt, self-hatred, and the perception that no one cares about the individual. Symptoms may include sadness, withdrawal, fatigue, apathy, anxiety, irritability, or a tendency to lash out. Be vigilant for expressions that reflect the thought patterns and feelings associated with suicidality. The following statements are often made by suicidal individuals: “Life is not worth living.” “You (or another friend or family member) would be better off without me.” “Don’t worry, I won’t be around to see that.” “You will regret it when I’m gone.” “I won’t be a burden much longer.” “I just can’t cope with everything – it’s pointless.” “I won’t be a burden for much longer.” “There’s nothing I can do to change anything.” “I would be better off dead.” “I feel like there’s no way out.” “I should never have been born.” Many people who commit suicide appear to feel significantly better shortly before. What you may be observing is peaceful determination because the person has made the decision to end their life. In this case, immediate preventive measures must be taken. Many behavioral changes can be observed in suicidal individuals. If you notice at least a few of the following signs, there may be cause for concern: decline in performance at school, work, or other activities (or occasionally the opposite, by filling time with extra tasks and responsibilities), social isolation, little or no interest in sex, friends, or activities that the individual previously enjoyed, indifference to personal well-being and deterioration of appearance, changes in sleep or eating habits that can go in both directions. Watch for extremes such as refusal to eat, poor eating habits, or ignoring medical advice (especially in the elderly), drastic changes in existing routines, apathy, and withdrawal. If they have already devised a plan, it could mean that a successful suicide attempt may happen soon. Watch for the following actions: settling outstanding matters (such as saying goodbye to loved ones, giving away valuable possessions, or making financial arrangements), making reckless or passive decisions about important things, collecting tools needed for a suicide attempt, such as pill bottles, medications, and weapons.

Imagine you are in a bar and you see a cute boy or girl standing in the corner. Within the first three seconds, you imagine talking to them and getting their phone number. Then doubts set in and fear overwhelms you. That is the point where you should stop overthinking. Stop after those three seconds. Just go. Don’t get trapped in your own head. Any thinking after those first three seconds will only lead to more worries, and these worries will do you no good. Silence that voice in your head and go before it tells you not to do it. The voice has no idea what it’s talking about! As we get older, we start to think that the whole world is constantly pointing fingers at us and is ready to point out our mistakes at any moment. In reality, the rest of the world is too busy with themselves to pay us any attention, and everyone is afraid of the same things. The only person who cares about how you appear to others is yourself. Essentially, you have to be quite conceited not to feel confident. Does everyone stare at you and laugh? Does everyone think about what you say or do? Sure, maybe in your world, but definitely not in anyone else’s. This is not sad; it’s liberating. Only your opinion matters. Laughing fills your brain (and thus your entire self) with a true sense of happiness. It releases tension, lifts your mood, and makes it easier to show that genuine smile. All of this makes it ten times easier to fake confidence, which also makes it ten times more convincing. Appearing confident can be difficult, but seeming carefree and positive is somewhat easier. Therefore, laugh when someone makes a joke. Always keep a smile ready in case you need it. People like happy people, and being happy is associated with confidence. Remember your last bad hair day? You were probably quite insecure, right? And how was it the last time you dressed up and went out? Probably pretty good. Sometimes our brains pick up on external cues and decide how we feel inside based on them. If you need a boost of confidence, wear an outfit you know you look good in and get ready. Looking good makes it much, much easier to feel good. Additionally, people tend to make assumptions about those who are well-dressed and good-looking. They assume that they are more educated, smarter, wealthier, and generally more likable. It’s a human trait to judge a book by its cover. Use this to your advantage by dressing up. Many people easily confuse enthusiasm with confidence. If you can't show confidence, then this is a good way to go. Is your favorite song playing on the radio? Tell everyone how much you love it. Is someone suggesting to go see a movie you’ve been wanting to see? Say how excited you are about it. Your energy will be infectious and uplifting, and everyone will feel that you are full of positivity and confidence. However, make sure your body and words match. Imagine someone saying in a monotone voice, “I can’t wait to see this movie!” while looking down at their hands hidden in their pockets and turning their gaze away. You probably won’t be convinced. Now imagine a person whose eyes light up, who raises their arms and exclaims, “I can’t wait to see this movie!” Much more convincing. The human mind is sometimes an disturbingly powerful thing. Studies have even shown that the power of expectation can even make cancer retreat. This is known as the placebo effect. In the original studies, patients thought they were taking a medication, but they weren’t, and yet they felt better. If you tell yourself that you will succeed, then it is possible. And if you tell yourself that you can’t, then you probably won’t. Much in life is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If you don’t feel you have a reason to be confident, then you won’t be. If you think you will not perform well, then you will likely perform poorly. The right attitude can truly change everything. And the only thing that determines your attitude? That’s you.

Bodybuilders know that the path to a muscular body involves weight training. This form of strength training is intended to make your muscles bigger and stronger. You can train with weights at the gym or buy the necessary equipment for home use. Since this is an essential part of your program, you should plan several training sessions per week. If you do not want to pay for a gym, get a barbell and a set of weights to train at home. You can also try resistance exercises, which allow you to train your muscles without needing weights. Push-ups are an easy start. You can also hang a pull-up bar in a doorway to train your arms and chest. Even if there is a body part where you particularly want to gain muscle mass, you still benefit from training that engages all your muscle groups and not just a specific area. Invest the same amount of time in your arms, back, chest, abdomen, and legs. Instead of training all muscle groups on the same day, you should rotate between them so that each group has time to recover between sessions. Plan your week to ensure you train each muscle group equally often. For example, you could train your arms and chest one day, focus on your legs and abdomen the next day, and then take care of your back and chest on the third day. You might consider working with a personal trainer to create a schedule and training plan that meets your needs. Muscle mass is built by repeatedly stretching the fibers of your muscle tissue beyond their everyday stress limits. To do this, you must lift enough weight and perform enough repetitions so that your muscles feel tired and sore, but not to the point of injury. Find the right weights for each exercise by first determining what weight allows you to do eight to ten repetitions without needing to rest. If you can easily do more than ten repetitions, add more weight. If you have to stop after five, reduce the weight a bit. Compound exercises are your allies. Focus on complex compound exercises that require as many muscles as possible: bench presses, dumbbell presses, squats, deadlifts, pull-ups, and dips. It doesn’t matter if you can currently only press four to five kilos with the dumbbells. Whatever weight you start with, try to achieve a bit more each time. Push yourself, get stronger, lift more, and before you know it, you'll be packed with muscles. Try to keep your rest periods between exercises to one minute or less. Never do more than twelve repetitions per set. According to a study from the University of Birmingham, energy shakes can help improve your endurance during training. Consume a banana, a handful of dried fruits, or a sports energy shake right after training. Give your muscles rest between training sessions. This is important for your muscles to grow bigger and stronger. Your muscles recover on your rest days. You should never train the same muscle group two days in a row; only train it again once it has recovered. Wait at least 48 hours before training the same muscle group. To benefit from optimal muscle growth, you should also ensure you get eight to nine hours of sleep per night. If you sleep only six hours or less, you will not reap all the benefits that your training and nutrition offer.

Your future husband needs to understand that you like him not just for his money. He must see that you truly love him... and you should truly love him! Relationships are hard and they only work if you have a really close bond with that person. Don't make money a topic in your conversations (especially in the early stages) and try to be quite self-sufficient. If he wants a prenuptial agreement, don't fight it. You can even suggest one if you want him to feel better about it. Because it is common for rich people to be exploited, they tend to have normal issues with trust. You need to create an environment of trust. This will set you apart from all those other people and show him that you are the one he should marry. Be someone he can confide in, don’t judge him, and be open with him about your own secrets and insecurities. Don’t be the kind of date who lets everything happen to her. Take an active role in your dating! You should take him to places, even if the place isn’t very nice. Be flexible and respond well when things don’t go as planned. Ask him about those things you know he wants to talk about. Everyone wants to marry the person they believe will make their life better. If you are rich, you don’t have to worry about finding someone who cares for you. Instead, you are concerned with finding a partner who makes your life interesting and fun. If you want a marriage proposal, be that person. Bring him out of his shell. Make him do fun, fantastic things he would never have done otherwise. Always be positive and avoid complaining at all costs. He won’t be able to get enough of you! Be a master of the art of love. Not just the sexual part (although that doesn’t hurt): be good at truly loving him and help him fall in love with you. Be completely selfless in your relationship. Work on bringing him happiness. Surprise him now and then with signs of love. Be cheesy. That’s a good approach. Don’t give everything up right away. You can sleep with him if you want, but don’t sleep with him too often or spend all your time with him. Why would he marry you if he gets everything he wants from you as his girlfriend or mistress?

If you want to wake up early, you need to prepare to go to bed early, at least much earlier than expected. So really avoid drinking coffee after lunchtime. If you start to feel tired, there are other methods you can rely on; caffeine should be the last option. Even though a glass of wine or beer may make you sleepy after a long day, alcohol ultimately makes it harder to fall into deep sleep. Therefore, you may end up sleeping for eight hours after a night of drinking but still feel groggy the next morning. You can enjoy a glass of wine with dinner, but try to do this 2-3 hours before going to bed, as it will otherwise be harder to fall asleep and consequently to wake up early. If you eat dinner late and then go to bed, it will be more difficult to fall asleep since your body is still busy with digestion. Eat a healthy mix of vegetables, proteins like fish or chicken, and healthy carbohydrates, such as brown rice or whole grain pasta. Make sure to eat enough so that you don't wake up hungry in the middle of the night, but don't overeat either. Especially avoid eating very spicy, heavy, or creamy foods, as your body will have a harder time digesting them, keeping your digestion active. While it's important to drink enough water throughout the day, you should scale back 3-4 hours before bedtime. You won't want to get up at night to go to the bathroom. To make it easier for yourself to fall asleep, you should only use your bed for sleeping - and for sex, if that is relevant to you. If you work in bed, watch TV, or have long phone discussions with your best friend in it, you confuse your bed with a place where one should be awake, instead of sleeping. Be careful not to use this piece of furniture for other situations if you value a relaxed sleep. You can also read for a while in your bed before falling asleep. However, read something that relaxes you or takes you to a dream world and doesn't stress you out. Even if you think that watching TV or surfing the internet helps you feel sleepy, it is still counterproductive. You want your mind to be as calm and relaxed as possible before going to sleep. So, put your phone aside, turn off the TV and computer, and give your body time to prepare for sleep. You can play light, relaxing music like jazz or classical music. However, don't put on music that puts you in a party mood and keeps your mind from calming down. Everyone is different, so experiment until you find a routine that works for you. This could mean drinking a cup of chamomile tea, reading something, stretching, or listening to classical music. It could also be a combination of these things or something completely different. Perhaps you like to brush your hair before bed or want to put on a silk pajamas. Find a routine that you enjoy and stick to it. This way, your mind knows when it's time to go to bed. Although some people like to take warm baths before bed, you should do this a few hours before going to sleep. A warm bath raises your body temperature and keeps it up, making it harder to fall asleep. This is a very important point if you really want to be able to wake up early. It's important to get 7-9 hours of sleep per night, but it's equally important to have a regular sleep rhythm so that your body gets used to it. Choose a time plus or minus 30 minutes and stick to this time when you go to bed and wake up the next morning. You will be amazed at how easy it will be for you to get up after you have kept this routine for a while. If you know you have to get up early the next morning and try to go to bed three hours earlier, it probably won't work. You need to gradually get your body used to falling asleep early and waking up early again. Some people like to catch up on sleep over the weekend. You can certainly allow yourself a little more sleep - about an hour is absolutely fine - but if you drastically increase your sleep quota, it will be harder to fall back into your rhythm at the beginning of the week. Place your alarm clock on the other side of the room, on your dresser, or simply far enough away that you have to get up to turn it off. With the alarm clock right next to you, it’s easier to hit the snooze button, and you want to avoid that. Logically, however, you should not place the alarm clock so far away that you can't hear it. If you really want to force yourself to get up, you can set a second alarm clock in another room. This way, you force yourself to get up, but you run no risk of not hearing the alarm. Just before you fall asleep, imagine what the next day will look like. Picture the alarm going off, you opening your eyes, and then reaching for it. Imagine doing this while smiling, stretching your arms above your head, yawning, and getting up. Visualize drinking a glass of water, going to the bathroom, and starting your day in a good mood and early. If you can visualize this scenario, it will be much easier to turn that image into reality the next morning. While it may be hard for you to get up in the morning, remember how easy it looked in your imagination and try to live up to that image. After you finish your evening routine, all you have to do is crawl into bed and close your eyes. There are a few small things to keep in mind before you do this. Here are some suggestions for total relaxation. Do not do stressful tasks in the evening. Avoid arguing with your partner, answering work emails, or having a strenuous phone call. Postpone stressful tasks until the next day so that you do not go to bed agitated. Let fresh air into the room. The body relaxes better when it is not exposed to heat.

In the event that your parents agree to let you go, you should let them feel that you appreciate their trust in you. Thank them after they say yes and then again after the event. Remember, they don't have to let you do this, and you don't want them to regret it. If you're looking for bonus points, then make a thank-you card for your parents or give them a small gift to show your gratitude. If you are going to someone's house for the event, then send them a thank-you card as well. If you told your parents that you would call them at a specific time to check in, then do that. If you told them you would be home at a certain time, then do not be late. It is not enough to want to keep your promises—you actually have to do it. Talk to your parents before you go out. Ask them to remind you of what is expected of you, and write it down so you don't forget. The more you stick to your agreements and reassure them during the event, the easier it will be for them to let you go out next time. If your parents get easily worried or are rather strict, you should not give them any reason to doubt you or worry about you. Be aware of what you post on social media, and try to prevent your parents from seeing anything that might worry them. Clear your browser history if you are searching for things on the internet. If you use Facebook, change the settings so that you have to approve everything that is posted about you. This way, your friends cannot tag you in anything that could get you in trouble later. If you need to hide things, choose a good place where your parents will not find them. The attic and the basement are usually a good choice.

Fill a bowl or sink with warm water and some mild hand soap. Place your hands in the bowl or sink so that your glued nails are completely submerged in the water. Hold them there for about fifteen minutes. The soap and water will be absorbed by the nail glue and soften it, making it easier to remove. You can also soak your nails in a little pure acetone to soften the glue. However, be aware that acetone is much harsher on your skin, nails, and cuticles than soap and water. Alternatively, you can soften your nail glue by applying a few drops of cuticle oil to each artificial nail and letting it soak for a few seconds.

SEO is a strategy that web developers use to increase the likelihood that someone will find their website during a search. There are both simple and complex ways to optimize your blog for search engines. Read about how other people do this and decide which strategy is suitable for your skills, needs, and content. The most popular way to improve your ranking in search engines is to ensure that you use the words that people are searching for. Take the perspective of your potential readers. Look for a few topics related to your blog themes in different search engines and see which websites appear on the first page. Read these pages carefully – which words seem to be in each paragraph, which words are repeated frequently in the headlines? Make allies, try to convince them to link to your blog from time to time. Share the link to your blog regularly. The more often people click on your link and the closer the connection to related popular blogs, the more likely it is that you will appear in the search engine.

Fill a drinking glass about halfway with beer. Place a shot glass in the beer so that it does not sink. Then, one by one, pour soju into the shot glass. The goal is to keep it from sinking. The person who causes the glass to sink must drink the beer-soju mixture (called Somek). The more people you have, the better. At any point, call out "Noonchi Game One!" to start the game. After that, players can take turns saying the next consecutive number until they reach the number of players present. For example, if you are five people, you would count up to five. The challenge is that no two people can say the same number at the same time. If, for example, two people say "Two!" at the same time, they must both take a drink. If your group manages to count to the last number, the person who said the last number must drink a glass.

Your frame is ready, and you can now start building the catapult. The upper side of the catapult should have 45 cm long boards pointing straight up, while the 90 cm long boards lie sideways. Screw another 45 cm long board vertically between the two at the top of the 45 cm long slats, creating a crossbar. The crossbar and slats should be flush at the top. For this, use the approximately 75 cm long slats. Measure 6.5 cm from the end and drill a hole about 1 cm wide through the flat side of the slat, across its entire width. Screw a plastic basket or similar to the middle of the flat side. This should be on the opposite side from the drilled hole. You can try all sorts of containers, from a basket to a salad bowl. Drill a 1 cm wide hole on each side of the base in the end with the triangle. The hole should be about 15 cm from the end of the 45 cm long slats, where the triangle should also end. Then measure about 6 cm above the lower side and drill. The arm of the catapult operates by being pulled back and released. To prevent the launching arm from damaging the catapult when it hits it during firing, you should pad the arm, for example with a thick blanket or a few old cushions.

The triggers for postpartum depression and anxiety are negative thoughts. If you think unhealthy thoughts often enough, they can become automatic and even comforting. To overcome this postpartum illness, you must overcome these negative thoughts, which requires recognizing them first. There are many different types of negative thoughts. The most common negative thoughts that occur with postpartum depression are: All-or-Nothing Thinking means seeing everything in black or white. If you perform poorly once, you may see yourself as a total failure. Overgeneralization means viewing a single negative occurrence as a never-ending pattern of defeat. Mental Filtering means focusing on a negative detail and dwelling on it. Rejecting positive meanings and dismissing positive experiences means that they never happened. Emotional reasoning means believing that the negative feelings you perceive reflect reality, even if that may not be the case. Claims that you think you 'should' have done something mean that you feel guilty for not doing something. Personalization occurs when you see yourself as the cause of an incident that was actually completely outside your control. This way, you can view your negative thoughts more objectively. Take a piece of paper with you. When you feel negative thoughts coming on, you can write down what you were thinking and what led you to think negatively. For example: If you catch yourself thinking, “I can’t do anything right because my baby won’t stop crying,” you should write that thought down. You should also note what led you to think that way. Your baby might have been sleeping and suddenly started crying out of nowhere. Sometimes we cannot recognize what is right for us because we are too focused on a certain thought in our heads. This is the case with postpartum depression and anxiety. Try to distance yourself from your negative thoughts and think about the positive things. Acknowledge the things you have achieved. For example: If your negative thought is, “I can’t do anything right,” you should think about something bigger, like the fact that this baby needs you, or something smaller, like the fact that you successfully fed your child this morning. Instead of putting yourself down in a hurtful and judgmental way, treat yourself the same way you would treat a friend. You wouldn’t criticize a friend and tell them that they are doing everything wrong. You would highlight the positive things they have done and praise them for their kindness. You must treat yourself this way if you want to recover from your postpartum depression. Instead of blaming yourself for your problems, consider all other factors that may influence the situation. This way, you will realize that you are not responsible for every mishap in your life. For example: If your baby is asleep and wakes up in the middle of the night, you shouldn’t think, “I’m a bad mother because I can’t get my baby to sleep all night.” Instead, think about the causes that might have woken your baby up. Is your baby hungry? Was it disturbed by a loud noise? It is not your fault if your baby wakes up, but it is your responsibility to ensure your baby can go back to sleep by figuring out what they need.

Breathe some fresh air. Spending just 15 to 20 minutes outdoors is beneficial for your mental and physical health. Your time outside increases your vitamin D intake, which is good for your immune system. Being outdoors has been shown to reduce stress and improve brain function. Physical exercise has proven effective in boosting self-confidence and enhancing mood. Do something that you enjoy. If your choice of exercise exhausts you, take it easier. Walking is a great form of exercise. You might enjoy a long walk in a natural setting or your favorite shopping area. Have a dance party in your kitchen. You can move to your favorite songs with no one watching you. Decide how many days a week you want to work out. For most people, three days a week is manageable and will have an impact on your physical health. Tools that you can find online can help you reach your goals. Plans like "Couch to 5K" offer safe and goal-oriented programs. Ensure that your goal focuses more on your fitness rather than on weight loss. Personal trainers are fitness professionals. If you're having trouble starting an exercise routine, a trainer can help you. Some personal trainers work in specific gyms, while others will meet with you in their home or yours. If gyms aren't your thing, a meeting in a private setting might feel better for you. You can also work out with a friend. Choose a buddy who enjoys meeting with you regularly. Exercise is fun because it’s also social. You can join an amateur team in your city or start your own team. Some sports are more active than others. In soccer and basketball, most players are actively running around during the game. Golf and baseball have a slower pace. Play for fun. Don’t get caught up in competition. Group fitness can be fun and encouraging. When you're in a class, you'll feel like you truly belong. This also provides you with fun social interaction. Most gyms offer their members free classes. You can try different classes and stick with the ones you enjoy. Most cities offer free meet-ups for workout groups. People gather in parks or other places to exercise or bike together. Always ensure that the exercise you choose is healthy for your body. Your doctor can provide recommendations or suggest alternatives.

Put up flyers in your neighborhood to let people know that they can drop off recyclable materials at your place or another nearby location. Take these materials to a recycling center. This is especially helpful if you live in a small community that doesn’t have its own recycling center for items like electronics, batteries, and paint cans. A community center or local cinema would be a great place to raise awareness about ecological issues through films like An Inconvenient Truth, The Day After Tomorrow, Soylent Green, or Erin Brockovich. If children are attending, you might also show WALL-E or FernGully: Christa and Zak's Adventures in the Rainforest. If you organize everything early enough, you might be able to participate in a larger festival with your movie event and reach even more people. This shows participants how important it is to consider where products come from and how they are made in order to reduce their ecological footprint. Invite local artists and craftsmen to showcase their sustainable products. For example, select artists who use recycled materials in their projects or knitting workshops that create clothing and accessories from eco-friendly and vegan yarns. An ecological café or an alternative bookstore would be suitable locations for interesting and creative people to come together and share their ideas, concerns, and hopes, united by their love for nature. Poems and texts related to nature and environmental protection should be recited. Small dramatic readings or performances could also fit into the concept. For instance, poems like “Flood” by Neruda or excerpts from Walt Whitman's Leaves of Grass could be read. This is a great way to bring people together for a good cause. Invite local musicians to play at your open-air event. There may be musicians who build their instruments from recycled materials or whose music deals with environmental themes. You can charge an entrance fee and donate the money to an environmental project, such as for endangered species. Alternatively, you could simply set up a donation box so that visitors can make a voluntary contribution. If you don’t want to charge admission, you could make it a requirement that people donate refundable bottles or help with a neighborhood cleanup in order to see the performance. You could have the bands play songs at the concert like “Mother Nature’s Son” by the Beatles or John Mayer's “Waiting on the World to Change” to help increase oxygen in the air. Trees are great for the environment as they convert carbon dioxide into oxygen. Gather a group of people to plant new trees in your area. For public spaces like parks, you will need a permit, but you can plant freely in your garden or the gardens of your friends. Encourage your neighbors to help clean up and beautify your street. Pick up trash, pull weeds, and perhaps even repair and paint fences and houses. There are also many ways for children to get involved. Invite adults and children from the neighborhood to participate in a nature treasure hunt. Write a list of things to find and observe, such as a yellow flower, a green leaf, a ladybug, a feather, a smooth stone, a blade of grass, a cloud, something blue, and so on. You can prepare small prizes for the winners, such as eco-friendly shopping bags. Build (with permission) a stand in front of the library or supermarket. Talk to people about environmental protection issues and distribute brochures or information packages. This way, you can introduce many new aspects of environmental protection to others.

Don't present your request out of nowhere. Instead, let the idea sit for a week and then casually bring it up in conversation. Mention that you tried the game at a friend's house and that it was incredibly fun. They will likely realize that you want to ask for it, but at least they won't be surprised when you do. Waiting until your parents seem distracted might seem like a good idea because they are more likely to say yes in that moment, right? Actually, they will quickly realize that you are trying to take advantage of the situation and will forbid it even more. So find a time when your parents are relaxed and in a good mood, and have a few minutes to talk about it with you. They need to agree on such decisions. Even if you know that your mother or father is more likely to agree, they will still buy the game together. Therefore, it is advisable to present it to both of them at once. Ask them in advance to give you time to present your entire pitch without interruptions. Show them your speech or notes that you have prepared. Hopefully, this will impress them enough to soften their position before you even start your presentation. If you don't feel comfortable giving a speech with notes, you can also write it out and read it. When you give your presentation, you need to ensure that your parents can hear and understand you clearly. Speak loudly and clearly, and make eye contact as often as possible. The last thing you want is to ruin all your hard work by sounding rude or childish. Always be polite and respectful during your presentation to show your parents that you take this discussion seriously and that you are mature enough to make your request. If your parents still forbid it, don't lose your nerve right away. The fight isn't lost yet! Think coolly about the arguments your parents might give you and do your best to counter them. Even after all this hard work, your parents might still say "no." If that happens, you should just let it go. If you keep bothering them about it, it will only irritate them, and they won't give in next time either.

If you suspect your drain is clogged with hair or other solid materials, you may be able to remove it with an old bent wire hanger. Straighten the wire hanger as much as possible, then bend one end into a small hook that fits through the drain of the sink or basin. Push it into the drain with the hook facing forward. Try to slide the wire along the wall of the pipe instead of pushing it down the middle, as this prevents pushing the clog deeper into the pipe. Once you feel resistance, twist and move the hanger around to try to catch the clogging material with the hook. Pull the wire out to remove as much material as possible. Let hot water run from the tap for a few minutes; the water should be as hot as possible and flow with as much force as you can manage. Stop the water if it does not drain properly and the sink starts to fill up. Take a standard plunger and press it down forcefully several times to suck the clog out. If you are working with a double basin with two drains, firmly press a wet cloth over one drain to seal it. Position the plunger over the other drain hole and keep it upright. Fill the sink with about 7-10 cm of water around the plunger to help seal it against the drain. Push the handle of the plunger down hard, forcing water into the drain. Pull the handle back up and repeat the process with strong movements. Make sure the contact between the plunger and the sink is not broken. On the last upward movement of the handle, tilt it slightly to the side so that the plunger comes loose from the sink, and then remove it. You may need to pump this way for several minutes to dislodge the clog. There is a U-shaped pipe where waste can easily accumulate before entering the actual drain pipe. The trap is located just below the sink and can be removed and cleaned manually. Place a large bucket under the trap to catch any water and debris that flows out when you open it. Use a pipe wrench to loosen the flanges under the sink and on the drain pipe, then remove them by hand. Carefully pull the connections apart and take out the U-shaped pipe. Use a small wire brush to remove any stuck debris from it. Empty this into the bucket. Rinse it carefully with hot water, preferably in a different sink or basin to prevent flooding. Reassemble the trap. If existing rubber or plastic seals appear worn, replace them with new ones. This is necessary if the clog is deeper in the pipe. Remove the trap and the pipe leading from it to the wall. Unroll about 15-25 cm of the cleaning snake. Insert this piece of the snake into the wall opening of the pipe. Turn the handle on the other end of the snake clockwise while simultaneously pushing the snake further into the pipe. Initial resistance may come from bends in the pipe through which the snake must navigate. If you feel you have hit the clog, continue turning clockwise until you feel you have broken through. You will also feel a release in the snake after it has broken through. Now turn the handle counterclockwise while pulling the snake out. Clean the snake as you pull it out. Repeat this process as needed until you can no longer feel any blockage. Then reinsert the trap.

Our bodies quickly adapt to diet and exercise routines. Keep your body curious by changing your fitness plan. This will help you overcome plateaus and prevent weight gain. Alternate between 6 small meals in one day and 3 larger meals the next. Throughout the week, switch between cardio and strength training exercises. Weight loss can often trigger cravings or the desire to overeat. The best way to avoid cravings is to eat in moderation what you long for. If you constantly deny yourself something, you are more likely to experience cravings. When you have lost weight, your stomach has probably shrunk, which means you need less food to feel full. Listen to your body and eat only as much as necessary to feel satisfied. If you fall back into your old eating habits after reaching your target weight, you will definitely regain some, if not all, of the weight. If you are constantly suffering, you will eventually give up your diet and exercise plan—that's only natural. Find a lifestyle that you feel comfortable with. Choose an exercise that you enjoy. If you have fun, you are more likely to stick with it in the long run.

If you spend some time recognizing your natural strengths and talents, you can start to feel better about yourself overall and you will also be able to find ways to begin building relationships with other people who share the same interests. For example, if you have found that you are musically gifted, you can start thinking about ways to meet other people in a music-oriented environment. If you are not very good at sports, it might be a bit too challenging at first to decide to meet other people by joining a soccer club. Then, you will have to deal not only with your fear of approaching strangers but also with feeling nervous or uncomfortable about performing in sports. Now that you are starting to feel more comfortable around other people and have thought about your interests and talents, it is time to intensify your approach and look for opportunities to find lasting friendships. For example, if you enjoy reading, consider joining a local book club. You can take it easy and may not need to talk much during your first visits, but know that you will be surrounded by people who have the same interests as you and who want to hear what you have to say. If sports are your thing, look for ads for running clubs or university sports teams, or join a local gym and sign up for a group class. After a few sessions, you will notice familiar faces and you will know that you share something in common to talk about. If you don’t have time in your schedule for regular events, you might still be able to connect with others by attending concerts, readings, plays, or talks in your area. People often linger after these events, or you might start noticing familiar faces after attending a few concerts. In this case, you could have an opening for conversation and perhaps a new friendship. Another great way to meet people is to recognize causes that are important to you and volunteer for them. For example, you can work to build houses for those in need, read to elderly people in nursing homes, or work for a political campaign. After you have attended a few club meetings, concerts, or volunteer sessions and have had a few conversations under your belt, challenge yourself to take the initiative and invite someone to do something with you. For instance, if you joined a running club and have talked to Sam a few times, you could tell him you’re thinking about participating in a 5K run next week. Ask him if he wants to sign up so you can run together. Or maybe you’ve been to a book club a few times and found out that a famous author will be visiting the local college campus next week. Invite the other club members to go with you to the reading and suggest that you all go to a café afterward. If you are truly a loner at heart, you can easily follow the call of your couch and Netflix list and find excuses to cancel your plans. Try to find ways to make it harder for yourself to back out of your plans. If others are counting on you, you are less likely to come up with excuses to be unsocial. For example, if you told your coworkers that you are going out for dinner together on Friday, you might think about calling in “sick” at 6 PM. However, if you agreed to pick up your coworker and drive her to the restaurant, it will be much harder for you to back out and spend the evening alone. Even if you are really unhappy about being alone and you start desperately trying to find friends, it is important that you choose to spend time with people who will treat you well. You do not have to maintain a relationship that is unfulfilling, makes you feel bad about yourself, or is abusive, just for the sake of companionship. If you find after some time that it is still really difficult to step outside your comfort zone or if the thought of being near other people or in crowds makes you feel panicked or disgusted, you may be suffering from some degree of social phobia. If this is the case, you would greatly benefit from seeking professional help (either from a doctor or a therapist). Together, you can identify the root of your fear and work on a treatment plan that may include therapy, medication, or a combination of both.

A young puppy can learn to follow your commands, and if you start training early, you can prevent him from developing unwanted behaviors. Say "Sit," "Stay," and "Come" to your dog when you want him to do these things. While you shouldn't expect perfect behavior at such a young age, starting to use verbal commands lays the foundation for his obedience as he grows older. For a Malinois, this early training start could be crucial for developing a pleasant and agreeable personality. You should begin house training as early as possible. Regularly take your puppy outside and always bring him to the same spot so he learns to relieve himself only outdoors. Instead of punishing your dog for mistakes, praise him for good behavior and give him a treat. When he sits, relieves himself outside, or comes to you on command, pet him, tell him how smart he is, or give him a small treat right away. Starting this positive reinforcement early will encourage the dog to do things to please you in the future. This positive reinforcement can begin very early, and using it when the dog is young will help you in advanced training later on. Clicker training is based on rewards, using a distinct click sound when the dog does what you want. This sound helps the dog understand that he has shown the desired behavior. Clicker training is a very helpful method as it avoids confusion between trainer and dog. When the clicker is pressed at the right moment, your commands are clear. This can be very helpful when a dog is trained intensively, which is typical for Malinois. When your Malinois is still a puppy, training sessions should last no more than ten minutes. As the dog gets older, you can gradually extend each session to 30 minutes to an hour. Malinois enjoy learning, being active, and spending time with their owner, so most like to train several times a day. If you want your puppy to sit, wait for a moment until he naturally wants to sit. Then say "Sit," praise him and give him a treat. By repeating this, the dog will associate the behavior with positive reinforcement. Try practicing sitting while out walking. When you pause at a corner, be prepared to give your dog treats and reward him for sitting on his own when you stop. How long it takes your dog to learn to sit can vary greatly. It may take many repetitions for your dog to understand the command and the reason for the treats. "Sit" is the starting point for many other commands like "Stay" and "Down." For example, when your dog is sitting, you could say "Down" and indicate that he should lie down. You might need to wait until the dog lies down to give him a treat, just as you did with "Sit." Remember to use positive reinforcement by saying "Good dog" when he does something right. Repeat this every day until your dog reliably follows your commands.

In the later weeks of pregnancy, you are likely to experience back pain. However, if you are trying to distinguish between early pregnancy and PMS, back pain is more indicative of PMS. While both pregnancy and PMS can cause mood swings, depression is generally more associated with PMS. Therefore, if you are feeling somewhat depressed, it might be a sign that your egg did not implant. Although you can feel bloated at the beginning of a pregnancy, this symptom is more commonly associated with PMS. Your abdomen may also feel particularly tense with this symptom. Although this step may seem obvious, it is the clearest sign that you are not pregnant. Try to track the onset of your period by marking it on a calendar so that you know when it should occur again. This way, you will know if it has been missed and that you could be pregnant. The most effective way to determine if you are pregnant or simply experiencing PMS symptoms is to take a home pregnancy test. These tests are available at any pharmacy and come with easy-to-understand instructions. You can take a pregnancy test a few days before your period is due or when trying to determine if you have PMS or implantation symptoms. Some tests claim to be accurate at such an early stage. However, for a definitive result, you should wait until your period is at least a week late. In most cases, blood tests can detect the respective hormones only a few days earlier than early pregnancy tests. However, do not request a blood test merely out of curiosity, as your insurance may refuse to cover it.

When someone takes their bad mood out on you, the first step is to recognize that it has nothing to do with you. It can be very easy to be affected by someone's bad mood, to the point where you feel bad about yourself. Before you react, understand that it’s not about you. Moody people experience sudden mood swings and almost anything can trigger them. Keep this in mind when you notice someone having a mood swing. For instance, if your friend was in a good mood but suddenly becomes verbally aggressive because you disagree with them, remember that they are inherently moody. Consider that they have lost their temper in the past, even if it had nothing to do with you. If you hadn't disagreed, something else could have triggered their reaction. It can be helpful to think of a moody person like the weather. Their unpredictable nature can be frustrating but it’s not something you can control. Talking to a person experiencing a mood swing can sometimes help; they may just need to express what’s bothering them. If someone is asked directly what’s wrong, they might confront the fact that there’s really no reason to be upset, which could alleviate their bad mood. Be gentle in your approach; even if the person frustrates you, responding with aggression won’t help. Instead of asking, "What's wrong with you?", try saying something like, "I feel like you’ve been quite upset with me today. Is there something bothering you?" However, you should never accept verbal or physical aggression directed at you. If they shout, insult, or use strong language, don’t ask what's wrong. Instead, walk away until they calm down; you can talk about it later. Remember that you cannot control other people's moods, but you can control your own to a certain extent. If someone is having mood swings, it might affect your mood as well. Try to stay calm as much as possible. Remaining calm can prevent the situation from escalating. It’s normal to feel frustrated by mood swings, especially when they are directed at you; however, remind yourself: "I cannot control their mood, but I can control mine." For example, if your friend invites you to dinner and the waiter forgets to bring your drinks, and your friend quickly becomes very angry, you can understand that the waiter forgot in a busy restaurant, but your friend is creating a scene. You don’t need to become angry yourself. You don’t have to agree with them and be angry at the waiter as well. Instead, stay calm. Try to mentally distance yourself from the situation and avoid taking on your friend’s anger. Remember that moods, even bad ones, will pass. If someone tends to have mood swings, their negative reactions won’t last long. They will likely calm down just as quickly as they got angry. Remember that they will calm down, even if their mood has worsened. This is not a permanent solution. Mood swings are a problem, especially when they are taken out on you. Maintaining the right perspective can help you stay calm in the moment, but the underlying reasons for the mood swings should still be addressed.
